---
title: "Getting started with Julia"
---

## Setting up VS Code

1. Download and install [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/)
2. Install the **Julia** extension from the VS Code marketplace
3. Configure the Julia path in VS Code settings if needed

### Recommended Extensions

- **Julia Language Support** - syntax highlighting, code completion
- **Quarto** - for rendering notebooks and documents

## Installing Julia

Download Julia from [julialang.org](https://julialang.org/downloads/).

### Windows

1. Download the Windows installer (.exe)
2. Run the installer and follow the prompts
3. Add Julia to your PATH (optional but recommended)

### macOS

1. Download the macOS .dmg file
2. Drag Julia to Applications
3. Add to PATH: `export PATH="$PATH:/Applications/Julia-1.x.app/Contents/Resources/julia/bin"`

### Linux

```bash
# Using juliaup (recommended)
curl -fsSL https://install.julialang.org | sh
```

## Basic numerics

::: {#2 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
1 + 2, sin(1.0)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```
(3, 0.8414709848078965)
```
:::
:::



### Arithmetic

::: {#4 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
a = 10
b = 3
a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```
(13, 7, 30, 3.3333333333333335)
```
:::
:::



### Arrays

::: {#6 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
x = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
sum(x), length(x)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```
(15, 5)
```
:::
:::



## Functions

::: {#8 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
f(x) = x^2 + 2x + 1
f(3)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```
16
```
:::
:::



## Control Flow

### Conditionals

::: {#10 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
x = 5
if x > 0
    println("positive")
elseif x < 0
    println("negative")
else
    println("zero")
end
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
positive
```
:::
:::



### Loops

::: {#12 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
for i in 1:5
    println(i^2)
end
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
1
4
9
16
25
```
:::
:::



## Types and Structs

::: {#14 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
struct Point
    x::Float64
    y::Float64
end

p = Point(1.0, 2.0)
p.x, p.y
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```
(1.0, 2.0)
```
:::
:::
